abstract: Ceres Solver is Google's open-source C++ library for modeling and solving large, complicated optimization problems. It is the de-facto non-linear least squares engine behind bundle adjustment in structure from motion (SfM) / SLAM, camera intrinsic and extrinsic calibration, hand-eye calibration, photometric calibration, pose refinement, and general non-linear optimization on manifolds. Provides analytic, numeric, and automatic differentiation, sparse and dense linear solvers, trust-region (Levenberg-Marquardt, dogleg) and line-search strategies, and robust loss functions.
reason: De-facto non-linear least-squares engine for bundle adjustment, hand-eye, and calibration refinement. Production-grade with autodiff and robust losses.
title: Ceres Solver
